title: Median Salary per Role
scenario: Find the median salary for each 'role' across all projects. Return the result table as 'role' and 'median_salary'.
tableSchema: employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT)
hint: Use PERCENT_RANK() or ROW_NUMBER() to identify the middle element(s).
correctQuery: SELECT role, AVG(salary) AS median_salary FROM (SELECT role, salary, PERCENT_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY role ORDER BY salary) AS pr FROM employees) t WHERE pr BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.55 GROUP BY role;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT); INSERT INTO employees VALUES (101, 1, 'Dev', 30000), (102, 1, 'Dev', 40000), (103, 1, 'Dev', 50000);
